hero.title: Discover authentic Pakistani cuisine
hero.subtitle: Kebabish — The Taste of Home
hero.description: Fresh, homemade Pakistani dishes — delivered or picked up within 10 km of Hoogkarspel.

home.aboutTitle: From our kitchen to your table
home.aboutText: Kebabish was founded in Hoogkarspel with one goal: bringing the authentic flavors of Pakistan to West Friesland. Every dish is made fresh with care, just like at home.
home.why1Text: No ready-made meals — everything is prepared fresh every day.
home.why2Text: Traditional recipes and spices, just like home cooking.
home.why4Text: Through the website or straight via WhatsApp — whatever suits you.
home.deliveryTitle: We deliver within 10 km of Hoogkarspel
home.deliveryText: Including Bovenkarspel, Grootebroek, Lutjebroek, Westwoud, Wognum, Wervershoof and Enkhuizen.
home.ctaBannerText: Order easily through our website or send us a WhatsApp message.
home.storyImageAlt1: Marinated chicken roasting in the tandoor over open flames
home.popularNote: Prices on request — message us for the current price list.
